title: Prototype-stage operating mandates for Agents under G0 x A0
objective: Decide whether the maintainer may grant an Agent a written, expiring operating mandate under the active A0 path so it acts inside a bounded scope without asking for each step, while merge, release, Unity Editor, headset, and GitHub permission decisions stay with people.
current_question: Does the Prototype-stage operating mandates section added to GOVERNANCE.md, together with docs/governance/mandates/, stay inside the G0 x A0 authority boundary, and should it remain after the 7-day policy review?

assumptions.statement: A mandate grants no GitHub write, review, merge, release, or administrative permission and does not activate RFC 0006 membership.
The section was added by direct maintainer instruction on 2026-09-13 before a public review window had opened, so the change is a governance-policy edit that still owes its 7-day review.

options.summary: Keep the mandate mechanism as written: maintainer-granted, expiring, path- and action-bounded, no review window for grant or revocation, no GitHub permission.
trade_offs: Lets Agents run recurring stewardship without a person poking each step
Relies on the mandate file and the repository contract as the only guard rails until RFC 0006 activates

options.summary: Keep the mechanism but require a 7-day public notice before a new mandate takes effect.
trade_offs: Slows every prototype-stage adjustment by a week

options.summary: Revert the section and return to per-instruction Agent work until RFC 0006 is activated.
trade_offs: Reintroduces the dependence on a person for every step that the maintainer asked to remove

agreements: Any option keeps merge, release, Unity Editor, headset, and GitHub permission decisions with people.
disagreements: Whether a grant needs public notice before it takes effect is unresolved.
missing_evidence: One completed weekly steward run reviewed by someone other than the mandate's principal.

non_goals: No GitHub permission, branch-protection, or App installation change under any option.
execution.exact_next_action: Until 2026-09-22T09:00:00Z anyone may add a risk or counterexample delta. If none exists when the window closes, the weekly steward records OPT-KEEP-MANDATES by lazy consensus with decided_by process:mandate.weekly-steward.v1; if one exists, a person resolves the record.

reopen_conditions: RFC 0006 activation replaces mandates with Agent membership records.
A mandate run causes an effect outside its declared scope.
